history.summary: A recently-completed (2024) 1BR in Clavon, D05 Clementi/West Coast, near the future Clementi CRL station (670m) at $1100k / $2087 psf — about 3% below the $2160 median, with a reliable 4.3% resale CAGR over 281 transactions. Strong One-North/Clementi tenant location with a genuine future-MRT catalyst.
history.rating_rationale: D05 has real demand drivers: One-North tech cluster, NUS/Clementi, and the upcoming Cross Island Line at Clementi (CR17, ~670m) — a 500m-ish future-MRT uplift candidate. $2087 psf is ~3% under median, the resale-only 4.3% (well above the OCR baseline) is reliable over 281 txns, and $1.1M is liquid. 1BR is investor-niche and the resale-vs-new-launch-biased headline (5.6%) is correctly discounted to 4.3%, but fundamentals and the CRL catalyst support a Buy.
